basic_info.description: Inviting 2BR/2BA condo in Russian Hill with 1,070 sq. ft. and prime access to North Beach. The home features an airy living room with 10-ft ceilings, expansive kitchen with eating bar and dining area, and a wide hallway ideal for a home office. The primary suite offers a marble vanity and shower-over-tub; the second bedroom is served by a full guest bath. Wood floors throughout living areas, tile floors in kitchen and dining, plus ample storage. Lower level common area features exclusive-use front-loading laundry, additional storage, and 1-car parking in a shared side-by-side garage with access from Kent Street. HOA dues of $92/mo. includes insurance. Steps from Washington Square Park, dining, shopping, and nightlife.
